coverage.summary: The only available source, a secondary law-firm alert table, describes the Minneapolis ordinance's prohibition and remedy. It states no limits on covered buildings, unit counts, construction dates or landlord size.

evidence.quoted_span: Effective March 1, 2026. Prohibits algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data to advise on vacancy or rental rates; tenants may pursue civil actions.
